- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).

110	// NewFileServerService creates a new file server service.
111	func NewFileServerService(profile *profile.Profile, store *store.Store, secret string) *FileServerService {

120	// RegisterRoutes registers HTTP file serving routes.
121	func (s *FileServerService) RegisterRoutes(echoServer *echo.Echo) {
122		fileGroup := echoServer.Group("/file")

131	// serveAttachmentFile serves attachment binary content using native HTTP.
132	func (s *FileServerService) serveAttachmentFile(c *echo.Context) error {
133		ctx := c.Request().Context()
134		uid := c.Param("uid")
135		wantThumbnail := c.QueryParam("thumbnail") == "true"
136		wantMotion := c.QueryParam("motion") == "true"
137	
138		attachment, err := s.Store.GetAttachment(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
139			UID:     &uid,
140			GetBlob: true,
141		})
142		if err != nil {
143			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get attachment").Wrap(err)
144		}
145		if attachment == nil {
146			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "attachment not found")
147		}
148	
149		if err := s.checkAttachmentPermission(ctx, c, attachment); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152	
153		if wantMotion {
154			return s.serveMotionClip(c, attachment)
155		}
156	
157		contentType := s.sanitizeContentType(attachment.Type)
158	
159		// Stream video/audio to avoid loading entire file into memory.
160		if isMediaType(attachment.Type) {
161			return s.serveMediaStream(c, attachment, contentType)
162		}
163	
164		return s.serveStaticFile(c, attachment, contentType, wantThumbnail)
165	}

167	// serveUserAvatar serves user avatar images.
168	func (s *FileServerService) serveUserAvatar(c *echo.Context) error {
169		ctx := c.Request().Context()
170	
171		// On a private instance (no InstanceURL), avatars are not exposed to anonymous
172		// visitors; a valid session, access token, or PAT is required.
173		if !s.Profile.AllowAnonymous() {
174			viewer, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
175			if err != nil {
176				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
177			}
178			if viewer == nil {
179				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
180			}
181		}
182	
183		identifier := c.Param("identifier")
184	
185		user, err := s.getUserByUsername(ctx, identifier)
186		if err != nil {
187			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get user").Wrap(err)
188		}
189		if user == nil {
190			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "user not found")
191		}
192		if user.AvatarURL == "" {
193			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "avatar not found")
194		}
195	
196		imageType, imageData, err := s.parseDataURI(user.AvatarURL)
197		if err != nil {
198			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to parse avatar data").Wrap(err)
199		}
200	
201		if !avatarAllowedTypes[imageType] {
202			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid avatar image type")
203		}
204	
205		setSecurityHeaders(c)
206		c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderContentType, imageType)
207		c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderCacheControl, cacheMaxAge)
208	
209		return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, imageType, imageData)
210	}

216	// serveMediaStream serves video/audio files using streaming to avoid memory exhaustion.
217	func (s *FileServerService) serveMediaStream(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, contentType string) error {
218		setSecurityHeaders(c)
219		setMediaHeaders(c, contentType, attachment.Type)
220	
221		switch attachment.StorageType {
222		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
223			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
224			if err != nil {
225				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to resolve file path").Wrap(err)
226			}
227			http.ServeFile(c.Response(), c.Request(), filePath)
228			return nil
229	
230		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
231			presignURL, err := s.getS3PresignedURL(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
232			if err != nil {
233				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to generate presigned URL").Wrap(err)
234			}
235			return c.Redirect(http.StatusTemporaryRedirect, presignURL)
236	
237		default:
238			// Database storage fallback.
239			modTime := time.Unix(attachment.UpdatedTs, 0)
240			http.ServeContent(c.Response(), c.Request(), attachment.Filename, modTime, bytes.NewReader(attachment.Blob))
241			return nil
242		}
243	}

245	// serveStaticFile serves non-streaming files (images, documents, etc.).
246	func (s *FileServerService) serveStaticFile(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, contentType string, wantThumbnail bool) error {
247		// Generate thumbnail for supported image types.
248		if wantThumbnail && thumbnailSupportedTypes[attachment.Type] {
249			if thumbnailBlob, err := s.getOrGenerateThumbnail(c.Request().Context(), attachment); err != nil {
250				if !errors.Is(err, errUseOriginalForThumbnail) {
251					slog.Warn("failed to get thumbnail", "error", err)
252				}
253			} else {
254				setSecurityHeaders(c)
255				setMediaHeaders(c, "image/jpeg", attachment.Type)
256				return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, "image/jpeg", thumbnailBlob)
257			}
258		}
259	
260		setSecurityHeaders(c)
261		setMediaHeaders(c, contentType, attachment.Type)
262	
263		// Force download for non-media files to prevent XSS execution.
264		if !strings.HasPrefix(contentType, "image/") && contentType != "application/pdf" {
265			c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderContentDisposition, fmt.Sprintf("attachment; filename=%q", attachment.Filename))
266		}
267	
268		switch attachment.StorageType {
269		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
270			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
271			if err != nil {
272				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to resolve file path").Wrap(err)
273			}
274			http.ServeFile(c.Response(), c.Request(), filePath)
275			return nil
276		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
277			reader, err := s.getAttachmentReader(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
278			if err != nil {
279				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get attachment reader").Wrap(err)
280			}
281			defer reader.Close()
282			return c.Stream(http.StatusOK, contentType, reader)
283		default:
284			return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, contentType, attachment.Blob)
285		}
286	}

292	// getAttachmentBlob retrieves the binary content of an attachment from storage.
293	func (s *FileServerService) getAttachmentBlob(attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
294		switch attachment.StorageType {
295		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
296			return s.readLocalFile(attachment.Reference)
297	
298		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:

301		default:
302			return attachment.Blob, nil

306	// getAttachmentReader returns a reader for streaming attachment content.
307	func (s *FileServerService) getAttachmentReader(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
308		switch attachment.StorageType {
309		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
310			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
311			if err != nil {
312				return nil, err
313			}
314			file, err := os.Open(filePath)
315			if err != nil {
316				if os.IsNotExist(err) {
317					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "file not found")
318				}
319				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to open file")
320			}
321			return file, nil
322	
323		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
324			s3Client, s3Object, err := s.createS3Client(attachment)
325			if err != nil {
326				return nil, err
327			}
328			reader, err := s3Client.GetObjectStream(ctx, s3Object.Key)
329			if err != nil {
330				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to stream from S3")
331			}
332			return reader, nil
333	
334		default:
335			return io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(attachment.Blob)), nil
336		}
337	}

371	// createS3Client creates an S3 client from attachment payload.
372	func (*FileServerService) createS3Client(attachment *store.Attachment) (*s3.Client, *storepb.AttachmentPayload_S3Object, error) {
373		if attachment.Payload == nil {
374			return nil, nil, errors.New("attachment payload is missing")
375		}
376		s3Object := attachment.Payload.GetS3Object()
377		if s3Object == nil {
378			return nil, nil, errors.New("S3 object payload is missing")
379		}
380		if s3Object.S3Config == nil {
381			return nil, nil, errors.New("S3 config is missing")
382		}
383		if s3Object.Key == "" {
384			return nil, nil, errors.New("S3 object key is missing")
385		}
386	
387		client, err := s3.NewClient(context.Background(), s3Object.S3Config)
388		if err != nil {
389			return nil, nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create S3 client")
390		}
391		return client, s3Object, nil
392	}

426	// getOrGenerateThumbnail returns the thumbnail image of the attachment.
427	// Uses semaphore to limit concurrent thumbnail generation and prevent memory exhaustion.
428	func (s *FileServerService) getOrGenerateThumbnail(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
429		thumbnailPath, err := s.getThumbnailPath(attachment)
430		if err != nil {
431			return nil, err
432		}
433	
434		// Fast path: return cached thumbnail if exists.
435		if blob, err := s.readCachedThumbnail(thumbnailPath); err == nil {
436			return blob, nil
437		}
438	
439		useOriginal, err := s.shouldUseOriginalForThumbnail(ctx, attachment)
440		if err != nil {
441			return nil, err
442		}
443		if useOriginal {
444			return nil, errUseOriginalForThumbnail
445		}
446	
447		// Acquire semaphore to limit concurrent generation.
448		if err := s.thumbnailSemaphore.Acquire(ctx, 1); err != nil {
449			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to acquire semaphore")
450		}
451		defer s.thumbnailSemaphore.Release(1)
452	
453		// Double-check after acquiring semaphore (another goroutine may have generated it).
454		if blob, err := s.readCachedThumbnail(thumbnailPath); err == nil {
455			return blob, nil
456		}
457	
458		return s.generateThumbnail(ctx, attachment, thumbnailPath)
459	}

461	// getThumbnailPath returns the file path for a cached thumbnail.
462	func (s *FileServerService) getThumbnailPath(attachment *store.Attachment) (string, error) {
463		cacheFolder := filepath.Join(s.Profile.Data, ThumbnailCacheFolder)
464		if err := os.MkdirAll(cacheFolder, os.ModePerm); err != nil {
465			return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create thumbnail cache folder")
466		}
467		filename := fmt.Sprintf("%s.v2.jpeg", attachment.UID)
468		return filepath.Join(cacheFolder, filename), nil

471	func (s *FileServerService) shouldUseOriginalForThumbnail(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) (bool, error) {
472		if attachment.Type == "image/heic" || attachment.Type == "image/heif" {
473			return true, nil

548	func (s *FileServerService) generateThumbnail(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, thumbnailPath string) ([]byte, error) {
549		reader, err := s.getAttachmentReader(ctx, attachment)

552		}

565		output, err := os.Create(thumbnailPath)
566		if err != nil {
567			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create thumbnail file")
568		}
569		defer output.Close()
570	
571		if err := imaging.Encode(output, thumbnailImage, imaging.JPEG, imaging.JPEGQuality(90)); err != nil {
572			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to save thumbnail")
573		}

575		return s.readCachedThumbnail(thumbnailPath)

580	// Small images are not enlarged.
581	func calculateThumbnailDimensions(width, height int) (int, int) {
582		if max(width, height) <= thumbnailMaxSize {

649	// checkAttachmentPermission verifies the user has permission to access the attachment.
650	func (s *FileServerService) checkAttachmentPermission(ctx context.Context, c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) error {
651		// For unlinked attachments, only the creator can access.
652		if attachment.MemoID == nil {
653			user, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
654			if err != nil {
655				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
656			}
657			if user == nil {
658				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
659			}
660			if user.ID != attachment.CreatorID && user.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
661				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden access")
662			}
663			return nil
664		}
665	
666		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{ID: attachment.MemoID})
667		if err != nil {
668			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to find memo").Wrap(err)
669		}
670		if memo == nil {
671			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "memo not found")
672		}
673	
674		// Public-visibility attachments are served to anonymous visitors only when the
675		// instance allows anonymous access. On a private instance (no InstanceURL), the
676		// request must still resolve to an authenticated user or a valid share token below.
677		if memo.Visibility == store.Public && s.Profile.AllowAnonymous() {
678			return nil
679		}
680	
681		// Check share token fallback: allow access if request carries a valid, non-expired share token
682		// that was issued for this specific memo. This covers attachment requests made from the shared
683		// memo page for private or protected memos.
684		if shareToken := (*c).QueryParam("share_token"); shareToken != "" {
685			ms, err := s.Store.GetMemoShare(ctx, &store.FindMemoShare{UID: &shareToken})
686			if err == nil && ms != nil && !isMemoShareExpired(ms) && ms.MemoID == memo.ID {
687				return nil
688			}
689		}
690	
691		user, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
692		if err != nil {
693			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
694		}
695		if user == nil {
696			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
697		}
698	
699		if memo.Visibility == store.Private && user.ID != memo.CreatorID && user.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
700			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden access")
701		}
702	
703		return nil
704	}

131	// serveAttachmentFile serves attachment binary content using native HTTP.
132	func (s *FileServerService) serveAttachmentFile(c *echo.Context) error {
133		ctx := c.Request().Context()
134		uid := c.Param("uid")
135		wantThumbnail := c.QueryParam("thumbnail") == "true"
136		wantMotion := c.QueryParam("motion") == "true"
137	
138		attachment, err := s.Store.GetAttachment(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
139			UID:     &uid,
140			GetBlob: true,
141		})
142		if err != nil {
143			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get attachment").Wrap(err)
144		}
145		if attachment == nil {
146			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "attachment not found")
147		}
148	
149		if err := s.checkAttachmentPermission(ctx, c, attachment); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152	
153		if wantMotion {
154			return s.serveMotionClip(c, attachment)
155		}
156	
157		contentType := s.sanitizeContentType(attachment.Type)
158	
159		// Stream video/audio to avoid loading entire file into memory.
160		if isMediaType(attachment.Type) {
161			return s.serveMediaStream(c, attachment, contentType)
162		}
163	
164		return s.serveStaticFile(c, attachment, contentType, wantThumbnail)
165	}

167	// serveUserAvatar serves user avatar images.
168	func (s *FileServerService) serveUserAvatar(c *echo.Context) error {
169		ctx := c.Request().Context()
170	
171		// On a private instance (no InstanceURL), avatars are not exposed to anonymous
172		// visitors; a valid session, access token, or PAT is required.
173		if !s.Profile.AllowAnonymous() {
174			viewer, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
175			if err != nil {
176				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
177			}
178			if viewer == nil {
179				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
180			}
181		}
182	
183		identifier := c.Param("identifier")
184	
185		user, err := s.getUserByUsername(ctx, identifier)
186		if err != nil {
187			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get user").Wrap(err)
188		}
189		if user == nil {
190			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "user not found")
191		}
192		if user.AvatarURL == "" {
193			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "avatar not found")
194		}
195	
196		imageType, imageData, err := s.parseDataURI(user.AvatarURL)
197		if err != nil {
198			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to parse avatar data").Wrap(err)
199		}
200	
201		if !avatarAllowedTypes[imageType] {
202			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid avatar image type")
203		}
204	
205		setSecurityHeaders(c)
206		c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderContentType, imageType)
207		c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderCacheControl, cacheMaxAge)
208

216	// serveMediaStream serves video/audio files using streaming to avoid memory exhaustion.
217	func (s *FileServerService) serveMediaStream(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, contentType string) error {
218		setSecurityHeaders(c)
219		setMediaHeaders(c, contentType, attachment.Type)
220	
221		switch attachment.StorageType {
222		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
223			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
224			if err != nil {
225				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to resolve file path").Wrap(err)
226			}
227			http.ServeFile(c.Response(), c.Request(), filePath)
228			return nil
229	
230		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
231			presignURL, err := s.getS3PresignedURL(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
232			if err != nil {
233				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to generate presigned URL").Wrap(err)
234			}
235			return c.Redirect(http.StatusTemporaryRedirect, presignURL)
236	
237		default:
238			// Database storage fallback.
239			modTime := time.Unix(attachment.UpdatedTs, 0)
240			http.ServeContent(c.Response(), c.Request(), attachment.Filename, modTime, bytes.NewReader(attachment.Blob))
241			return nil
242		}
243	}

245	// serveStaticFile serves non-streaming files (images, documents, etc.).
246	func (s *FileServerService) serveStaticFile(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, contentType string, wantThumbnail bool) error {
247		// Generate thumbnail for supported image types.
248		if wantThumbnail && thumbnailSupportedTypes[attachment.Type] {
249			if thumbnailBlob, err := s.getOrGenerateThumbnail(c.Request().Context(), attachment); err != nil {
250				if !errors.Is(err, errUseOriginalForThumbnail) {
251					slog.Warn("failed to get thumbnail", "error", err)
252				}
253			} else {
254				setSecurityHeaders(c)
255				setMediaHeaders(c, "image/jpeg", attachment.Type)
256				return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, "image/jpeg", thumbnailBlob)
257			}
258		}
259	
260		setSecurityHeaders(c)
261		setMediaHeaders(c, contentType, attachment.Type)
262	
263		// Force download for non-media files to prevent XSS execution.
264		if !strings.HasPrefix(contentType, "image/") && contentType != "application/pdf" {
265			c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderContentDisposition, fmt.Sprintf("attachment; filename=%q", attachment.Filename))
266		}
267	
268		switch attachment.StorageType {
269		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
270			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
271			if err != nil {
272				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to resolve file path").Wrap(err)
273			}
274			http.ServeFile(c.Response(), c.Request(), filePath)
275			return nil
276		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
277			reader, err := s.getAttachmentReader(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
278			if err != nil {
279				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get attachment reader").Wrap(err)
280			}
281			defer reader.Close()
282			return c.Stream(http.StatusOK, contentType, reader)
283		default:
284			return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, contentType, attachment.Blob)
285		}
286	}

426	// getOrGenerateThumbnail returns the thumbnail image of the attachment.
427	// Uses semaphore to limit concurrent thumbnail generation and prevent memory exhaustion.
428	func (s *FileServerService) getOrGenerateThumbnail(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
429		thumbnailPath, err := s.getThumbnailPath(attachment)
430		if err != nil {
431			return nil, err
432		}
433	
434		// Fast path: return cached thumbnail if exists.
435		if blob, err := s.readCachedThumbnail(thumbnailPath); err == nil {
436			return blob, nil
437		}
438	
439		useOriginal, err := s.shouldUseOriginalForThumbnail(ctx, attachment)
440		if err != nil {
441			return nil, err
442		}
443		if useOriginal {
444			return nil, errUseOriginalForThumbnail
445		}
446	
447		// Acquire semaphore to limit concurrent generation.
448		if err := s.thumbnailSemaphore.Acquire(ctx, 1); err != nil {
449			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to acquire semaphore")
450		}
451		defer s.thumbnailSemaphore.Release(1)
452	
453		// Double-check after acquiring semaphore (another goroutine may have generated it).
454		if blob, err := s.readCachedThumbnail(thumbnailPath); err == nil {
455			return blob, nil
456		}
457	
458		return s.generateThumbnail(ctx, attachment, thumbnailPath)
459	}

471	func (s *FileServerService) shouldUseOriginalForThumbnail(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) (bool, error) {
472		if attachment.Type == "image/heic" || attachment.Type == "image/heif" {
473			return true, nil
474		}
475	
476		if attachment.Type != "image/jpeg" && attachment.Type != "image/jpg" && attachment.Type != "image/png" && attachment.Type != "image/webp" {
477			return false, nil
478		}
479	
480		reader, err := s.getAttachmentReader(ctx, attachment)
481		if err != nil {
482			return false, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to open image for metadata probe")
483		}
484		defer reader.Close()
485	
486		probe, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, thumbnailMetadataProbeSize))
487		if err != nil {
488			return false, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read image metadata probe")
489		}
490	
491		return hasThumbnailSensitiveMetadata(attachment.Type, probe), nil
492	}

494	func hasThumbnailSensitiveMetadata(mimeType string, data []byte) bool {
495		if mimeType == "image/heic" || mimeType == "image/heif" {
496			return true
497		}
498	
499		for _, marker := range [][]byte{
500			[]byte("ICC_PROFILE"),
501			[]byte("iCCP"),
502			[]byte("ICCP"),
503			[]byte("cICP"),
504			[]byte("mDCv"),
505			[]byte("cLLi"),
506		} {
507			if bytes.Contains(data, marker) {
508				return true
509			}
510		}
511	
512		lowerData := strings.ToLower(string(data))
513		for _, marker := range []string{
514			"hdrgm:",
515			"hdr gain map",
516			"hdrgainmap",
517			"gainmap",
518			"ultrahdr",
519			"adobe:hdrgainmap",
520			"aux:hdr",
521			"auxiliaryimagetype",
522			"display p3",
523			"display-p3",
524			"rec.2020",
525			"bt.2020",
526			"arib-std-b67",
527			"smpte st 2084",
528		} {
529			if strings.Contains(lowerData, marker) {
530				return true
531			}
532		}
533	
534		return false
535	}

547	// generateThumbnail creates a new thumbnail and saves it to disk.
548	func (s *FileServerService) generateThumbnail(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, thumbnailPath string) ([]byte, error) {
549		reader, err := s.getAttachmentReader(ctx, attachment)
550		if err != nil {
551			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get attachment reader")
552		}
553		defer reader.Close()
554	
555		img, err := imaging.Decode(reader, imaging.AutoOrientation(true))
556		if err != nil {
557			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to decode image")
558		}
559	
560		width, height := img.Bounds().Dx(), img.Bounds().Dy()
561		thumbnailWidth, thumbnailHeight := calculateThumbnailDimensions(width, height)
562	
563		thumbnailImage := imaging.Resize(img, thumbnailWidth, thumbnailHeight, imaging.Lanczos)
564	
565		output, err := os.Create(thumbnailPath)
566		if err != nil {
567			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create thumbnail file")
568		}
569		defer output.Close()
570	
571		if err := imaging.Encode(output, thumbnailImage, imaging.JPEG, imaging.JPEGQuality(90)); err != nil {
572			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to save thumbnail")
573		}
574	
575		return s.readCachedThumbnail(thumbnailPath)
576	}

578	// calculateThumbnailDimensions calculates the target dimensions for a thumbnail.
579	// The largest dimension is constrained to thumbnailMaxSize while maintaining aspect ratio.
580	// Small images are not enlarged.
581	func calculateThumbnailDimensions(width, height int) (int, int) {
582		if max(width, height) <= thumbnailMaxSize {
583			return width, height
584		}
585		if width >= height {
586			return thumbnailMaxSize, 0 // Landscape: constrain width.
587		}
588		return 0, thumbnailMaxSize // Portrait: constrain height.
589	}

649	// checkAttachmentPermission verifies the user has permission to access the attachment.
650	func (s *FileServerService) checkAttachmentPermission(ctx context.Context, c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) error {
651		// For unlinked attachments, only the creator can access.
652		if attachment.MemoID == nil {
653			user, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
654			if err != nil {
655				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
656			}
657			if user == nil {
658				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
659			}
660			if user.ID != attachment.CreatorID && user.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
661				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden access")
662			}
663			return nil
664		}
665	
666		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{ID: attachment.MemoID})
667		if err != nil {
668			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to find memo").Wrap(err)
669		}
670		if memo == nil {
671			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "memo not found")
672		}
673	
674		// Public-visibility attachments are served to anonymous visitors only when the
675		// instance allows anonymous access. On a private instance (no InstanceURL), the
676		// request must still resolve to an authenticated user or a valid share token below.
677		if memo.Visibility == store.Public && s.Profile.AllowAnonymous() {
678			return nil
679		}
680	
681		// Check share token fallback: allow access if request carries a valid, non-expired share token
682		// that was issued for this specific memo. This covers attachment requests made from the shared
683		// memo page for private or protected memos.
684		if shareToken := (*c).QueryParam("share_token"); shareToken != "" {
685			ms, err := s.Store.GetMemoShare(ctx, &store.FindMemoShare{UID: &shareToken})
686			if err == nil && ms != nil && !isMemoShareExpired(ms) && ms.MemoID == memo.ID {
687				return nil
688			}
689		}
690	
691		user, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
692		if err != nil {
693			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
694		}
695		if user == nil {
696			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
697		}
698	
699		if memo.Visibility == store.Private && user.ID != memo.CreatorID && user.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
700			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden access")
701		}
702	
703		return nil
704	}

723	// sanitizeContentType converts potentially dangerous MIME types to safe alternatives.
724	func (*FileServerService) sanitizeContentType(mimeType string) string {
725		contentType := mimeType
726		if strings.HasPrefix(contentType, "text/") {
727			contentType += "; charset=utf-8"
728		}
729		// Normalize for case-insensitive lookup.
730		if xssUnsafeTypes[strings.ToLower(mimeType)] {

736	// parseDataURI extracts MIME type and decoded data from a data URI.
737	func (*FileServerService) parseDataURI(dataURI string) (string, []byte, error) {
738		matches := dataURIRegex.FindStringSubmatch(dataURI)
739		if len(matches) != 3 {
740			return "", nil, errors.New("invalid data URI format")
741		}
742	
743		imageType := matches[1]
744		imageData, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(matches[2])
745		if err != nil {
746			return "", nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to decode base64 data")
747		}
748	
749		return imageType, imageData, nil
750	}

757	// setSecurityHeaders sets common security headers for all responses.
758	func setSecurityHeaders(c *echo.Context) {
759		h := c.Response().Header()
760		h.Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
761		h.Set("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")
762		h.Set("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline';")

765	// setMediaHeaders sets headers for media file responses.
766	func setMediaHeaders(c *echo.Context, contentType, originalType string) {
767		h := c.Response().Header()
768		h.Set(echo.HeaderContentType, contentType)
769		h.Set(echo.HeaderCacheControl, cacheMaxAge)
770	
771		// Support HDR/wide color gamut for images and videos.
772		if strings.HasPrefix(originalType, "image/") || strings.HasPrefix(originalType, "video/") {
773			h.Set("Color-Gamut", "srgb, p3, rec2020")
774		}
775	}

71	// extractImageInfo extracts image type and base64 data from a data URI.
72	// Data URI format: data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo...
73	func extractImageInfo(dataURI string) (string, string, error) {
74		dataURIRegex := regexp.MustCompile(`^data:(?P<type>.+);base64,(?P<base64>.+)`)
75		matches := dataURIRegex.FindStringSubmatch(dataURI)
76		if len(matches) != 3 {
77			return "", "", errors.New("invalid data URI format")
78		}
79		imageType := matches[1]
80		base64Data := matches[2]
81		return imageType, base64Data, nil
82	}
